name: empty-state
title: Empty State
description: What to show when there is nothing to show: no data yet, no results, or nothing left to do.

examples.title: Empty state
examples.description: First-use state with one primary action.

examples.name: empty-state-actions
examples.title: Two actions
examples.description: A primary action and a help link.

examples.name: empty-state-in-card
examples.title: In a card
examples.description: The small size for filtered results inside a card or table.

props.name: title
props.description: What is empty, in plain words.

props.name: description
props.description: Why it is empty and what to do next. Wraps at 48 characters.

props.name: icon
props.description: Decorative icon shown in a small raised tile above the title.

props.name: action
props.description: The next step: usually one Button, optionally with a Link.

props.name: size
props.description: sm for cards, tables and popovers; md for pages and sections.

notes: The title is a real heading (h3 by default); pick the level that fits the page outline.
When the empty state replaces results after a search or filter, announce the change (e.g. a polite status message).

do: Say what will appear here and how to get it.
Offer the one action that fills the space.
Tell people when filters caused the empty result, and let them clear them.
dont: Don't blame the user or use jokes in error-adjacent states.
Don't add more than two actions.

typeNotes.note: level is 2 to 6, default 3. There is no 1: the page's own title is the h1. Use CardTitle level={1} or your page heading for that.
